decisions.reason: The software is adjacent to the firm's likely agency- and web-service knowledge base and already shows a positive customer signal, so the firm can plausibly learn and improve it rather than withdraw it.
A web hosting management platform fits very closely with an information-services firm's existing capabilities and its home-page prominence suggests it is strategic and unlikely to be removed soon.
A configurable managed hosting plan builds directly on established hosting know-how and can be refined with existing operational knowledge, making continuation more likely than exit.
